dek: A BOCOM International analysis argues Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 — 2.8 trillion parameters, natively multimodal, with a 1-million-token window — sits on the Pareto frontier of cost and capability, trailing only top closed models while cutting per-task cost sharply.
